sloka: स्व पुरम् च अगमत् श्रीमान् इष्ट यज्ञो महीपतिः ।गंगायाः च आगमे राजा निश्चयम् न अध्यगच्छत ॥१-४१-२५॥
transliteration: sva puram ca agamat śrīmān iṣṭa yajño mahīpatiḥ ।gaṁgāyāḥ ca āgame rājā niścayam na adhyagacchata ॥1-41-25॥

translations.english: The great lord of the earth (king Sagara) after performing the sacrifice reached his capital. (But) He could not devise any means to bring Ganga down to the earth.
